exposure: umbilical cord around the fetal neck
outcome: Peak systolic velocity of the umbilical artery (UMB PSV)
Persistence of the nuchal cord during delivery
cohort: 116 fetuses from single pregnancies in the third trimester with a mean age of 28.1 ± 0.79 weeks of gestation
finding: Fetal umbilical cord wrapping in the third trimester of pregnancy does not have a significant hemodynamic impact; however, the UMB PSV might be slightly elevated in this group, and the frequency of umbilical cord collision during delivery and the need to perform a cesarean section at term seem to be more common.
mod_finding: The frequency of cesarean section was significantly higher in the group of fetuses with the umbilical cord around the fetal neck (54.5% vs. 31.4%).
